agreement_id.description: the ID of the agreement to assign to the fleet

created_at.description: the date and time when the fleet was created

contractable.description: whether or not this fleet is allowed to start a contract

external_availability_group.description: whether the fleet is an external availability group

repair_order_number_required.description: whether repair order numbers are required for this fleet

exclude_rate.description: whether the fleet should use rates

pdf_agreement_url.description: the pdf of the agreement to assign to the fleet

program_type.description: A string representing the type of program the fleet is in (courtesy, rental, etc)

source_of_business.description: Source of business classification for the fleet

reservation_time_cap.description: the maximum amount of time a reservation should be active for, in days

reservation_time_cap_warning.description: the number of days before a reservation hits the cap that a warning should be sent

require_insurance_sufficiency.description: Specifies when insurance sufficiency checks are required (none, loaner, rental, or loaner_rental)

sales_lead_enabled.description: whether Service to Sales lead generation is enabled for the fleet

sales_lead_offset_hours.description: how many hours after service intake a sales lead should be created (1-12)

sales_lead_cms_config_email.description: email address the Service to Sales lead configuration should notify

misc.description: a JSON object for storing miscellaneous data
